prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, Polynesian goddess physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person; a powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere; thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing; her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame; solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, wolf cut ash brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro boarding-school set, a cropped sleeveless V-neck vest of ultra-thin matte cream fine rib knit with navy and gold stripes along the V and the hem, a small white collar and a slim striped tie at her throat, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the rib knit fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte forest-green rib knit with a thin gold stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, slightly darker skin over her elbows and a small beauty mark beside her navel. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin rib knit molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the navy and gold stripes on the vest and the fine pleats of the green skirt, a fine ribbed knit texture and fine stretch lines. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme Polynesian goddess silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy cream leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, in cream lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme, thick opaque layers piled on: an opaque thick white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line up to the brows, thick white paint under the lower lashes, a very wide bright turquoise liner flaring far past the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes top and bottom, opaque glossy white lips.

Background: a bright sun-dappled forest path with a packed earth floor, a waist-high wooden rail, a standard bench and tall straight trees, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
